answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The zenith edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 108 clones produces a signature the hollow analysis flags immediately. An attacker must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the haven settlement applies the void retroactively. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
